notes.title: Update of Those Who Came: Healing Solarus !!
notes.notes:
Hello Gamers!

We have been able to check the Those Who Came status, and gather some of the issues that might have been affecting you all on your journey through Solarus. From the different issues found and also notified by you, we have been able to address most of them!

We have identified a critical issue that could cause the game to get stuck and force the players to restart the mission, forcing them to go through an unnecessary set of menus and maps.

There was a mission that could be blocked if the players skipped a step by opening a door before being asked, now the mission will keep going if the case is matched.

In addition to this major fix, we have been able to identify a set of more quality of life improvements and issues that were affecting the experience:


 Language typos mostly happening in Spanish and Catalan
 At the start of a mission, an empty dialogue box could appear and never fade
 Certain trees have been relocated and now they are not floating
 Modified map boundaries to properly adjust to the playable pathing
 Visual issue with certain consoles when using the Surface Walker suit
 Visual issue with the energy tubes that they weren’t displayed at the right pace, but all of them at the end of the quest
 Visual issue where certain objects where being occluded and were hardly visible
 Improved the visuals for the healing plants to make it easier to see when is healing
 Adjusted the Torek archives and the batteries to only appear when not obtained 



We hope that with these fixes your experience with Those Who Came: Healing Solarus improves and helps you to reach Bineok. We need to save this world!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/32b903f9034d47313196d353918c27e445a0eea9.png

Also! If you'd like to be posted on the latest news, give us some human tips or just have a chat over coffee then you can always joing our discord server! The invite is just a click away ;) 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/7c2e73b9eb046815d27c28631cc2a6f26647ec2d.png

notes.title: The full version will come out on 30 August!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/2027a71c03f5313b46cc623c18c86f3bba982f86.png

Rolldbox Games is happy to announce that we have already completed the Full version of the video game and it will be available for you to download by August 30th.

It has been an intensive period since Early Access and we want first to thank all the community for all the comments, feedback and contributions that arrived to us, and to all the team! Now this is the amazing story completed. Enjoy it! 


Those who Came is a sci-fi cooperative adventure with some touch of RPG, where you will have to work as a team to survive and thrive on a hostile planet. Players must evade an astounding combination of challenges and environmental menaces, requiring lateral thinking, communication and, most importantly, cooperation! If you dare to play alone, you can! Be open to learning the different energies to move around!
And remember: it is about healing instead of killing!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/924e85ec079c63696446273ad68ff85ab4222df4.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/b5c0a97bd4487f0b2ab9e5646db8035470175a42.jpg



Don’t forget you can always join our Discord Community today and stay in touch!

notes.title: Full Demo Version of Those Who Came: Healing Solarus is now available
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/4352594371af205aa6d3a1a1955d9c16ae9a1cdf.png

Dear explorers of Planet Solarus 👽

As the almighty date of our final launch approaches, we are eager to announce major news in our endeavour. It has been a thrilling ride on our rockets, ready for the next chapter that the indie development world is ready to bring us.

March had been a month of showcasing the new prospects for Those Who Came: Healing Solarus inside the Game Developers Conference Spanish Pavillion, in San Francisco. We had the amazing opportunity to show the fruits of the massive feedback we gathered all these months, resulting in a Demo we’d love players all over the world to enjoy! 

Consequently, the jump of improvement in all aspects of the product has led us to the final decision of discontinue any Early Access update, as we feel the product we had does differ greatly from the final title you will all be able to see during summer. Instead of focusing our energy on small updates of the Early Access title, we prefer focusing on the final product. Fasten your seatbelts, great things are about to arrive!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/41752e9f03c463af195c898102aebeb180f641f1.png


THOSE WHO CAME DISCONTINUES EARLY ACCESS UPDATES

But what does this mean for our loyal players? 

If you purchased Those Who Came or you have a Key code, you will keep having access to the title once the date of our final launch ignites and publishes the game in our store.
By now, we will also ensure that you are able to play the Demo version available by selecting the named "PUBLICDEMO" in the Betas area. If you have any technical questions, don’t hesitate to ask! We would be happy to assess you through them all.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/76c168d4cbb8c3d78ca707bf1920e70b1d87e019.gif

NEW DEMO AVAILABLE

The Demo of Those Who Came: Healing Solarus is a special map created for this Demo, closely related to the game’s narrative and presenting key elements of both mechanics and a mysteriously important character you should beware. Your main goal is to discover why Solarus is corrupted and help the planet regain its past splendor with what you have at hand. 

Oh, explorers, don’t forget you can review the Demo for the sake of our future missions! We encourage you to bring your word of explorer.

Last but not least, we would like to thank everyone involved, from other developer teams to the amazing community and loving curators, in all the feedback that has led us to polish our game to the maximum level possible. We could not have done it without you! 



KEY FEATURES FOR THE FULL RELEASE:


 Choose your own style by using the energy with the different shapers: Airy, Ether, Firei and Jointer.
 Explore and find the different suits to interact with the world and restore life in Solarus to turn it into your new home. 
 The more you heal, the better it gets. By caring for the planet, you will be able to face the final challenge with some advantages.
 Play either alone or along with your friends, into a campaign with plenty of challenges to stop Bineok and his final experiment. 
 Dive into our Arcade mode, where you can face your friends in competitive PVP arenas. Harness the versatility of all 4 energies using them creatively on other players.


Don’t forget you can always join our  Discord Community today and stay in touch! 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/7c2e73b9eb046815d27c28631cc2a6f26647ec2d.png

See you at launch, explorer! 🚀

notes.title: Those Who Came Major Update !
notes.notes:
Greetings, fellow explorers! 

Today is a big day for Those Who Came. We are proud to announce our biggest update to date, a work that comes with several fixed issues and the introduction of a New Tutorial System to guide you through your first steps as a Sainen, among other juicy perks.  


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/979cc244a7a3eaf39a6cebe3a6b59ba997d1c667.png


Thanks to this much needed guidance, you will be learning to choose between Energies and know how to use them with the Shapers way faster and easier than in our previous update. Do not forget that the suit you wear is your battery and the source of your abilities. Charge your suit by absorbing energy from the environment and choose among the four Energies–Firei, Ether, Airy and Jointer–the one most attuned to you. The Shapers will enable you to leverage your energy for maximum effectiveness. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/13c43d559d9af0145dbebd6d382397721decba84.png


February 25th Update Features:

 We have added the second configuration of the Jointer: Jointer Mimic !
 The Energy System has been reduced to 10 levels. You will learn the second configuration of your Energy when reaching said level.
 Onboarding experience improved, as well as the Energy introductory levels, we highly recommend to replay the maps !
 These maps now contain a speedrun timer to see who is the fastest Sainen in the Galaxy!



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/6481b5f86bbc29f5e90cb7e48a9bbeaabbd6986e.png


February 25th Update Fixes:

 Fixed many issues related to the Mission System
 Translation related text mistakes fixed
 Cave Expedition issues fixed
 Navigation issues found in the game maps fixed 
 Issues with the color outlines related to energies solved
 Errors with the Steam icons when playing online resolved



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/9a03be7197591e1e60ff61608505d1c3d1ff39ca.png


Additional changes:

 The Quest Target icon has been changed for visibility purposes
 Improved navigation pathings on the caves for the last puzzles



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/c69d063c1d50e499c09ce8157a5c0c84b627f181.png


As Those Who Came nears its full release, some optional gameplay features will come out of the game to be refreshed and optimized for future post-launch updates while other exciting features will be introduced at launch for the first time. So stay tuned! 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/d2e8c4bee931da959f72b676989941f5616d6f47.png


Said that, we can’t wait to see you play our latest version of Those Who Came! Do you have any feedback? Tell us in the comment section, or join our Discord community today.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/7c2e73b9eb046815d27c28631cc2a6f26647ec2d.png


Happy gaming!

notes.title: The X-Mass update is now live!!
notes.notes:
Good day, explorers:

Our first major update, code-named 'X-Mass', is now live on Steam. As we revealed to you last week, it comes with very relevant changes in the way the Sainen abilities are introduced to players, new areas of Solarus to explore, and new ways of enjoying the experience both with friends and on your own. Also, the story of Solarus and the Sainen has been updated, with a lot of surprises for you to discover! There's a new trailer to celebrate this update, you can check below these lines.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/ce6fc7a05e052ec77afa4fb2fac49fafebc63bc0.jpg

This is a major milestone for us, as Those Who Came is beginning to take the shape we envisioned back in the day. We have been working extra hard these last weeks to ensure that the X-MASS update was ready before Christmas, so you and your friends have time to experience the game during your holidays.

If you are new to Those Who Came, you should be aware that we will live stream the game here on Steam at 12:30PM and 16:30PM (both CET). We will show the new mechanics featured in this update as well as the new maps and other quality of life improvements.

For more news, updates, or a friendly chat about the game, we invite you to follow and join the conversations here on the Steam forums, our community on Discord, and our social media channels: Twitter, Instagram, and Reddit.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: X-MASS update coming on December 9th
notes.notes:
Morning, explorers,

As we told you on Twitter last Friday, we are very happy to announce that the next major update for Those Who Came is about to be released. 

The update will hit Steam on December 9th with more content, technical improvements to the game's core features and much more. We truly believe this is a significant leap forward compared to previous builds, and one that puts us closer to our vision for Those Who Came. 

With this new update, we have made some changes to our roadmap, you can check them below.


⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/897d5fcd308117a21597f6152a386c4aca88971b.jpg

Among the new features, we have renamed some mechanics, and introduced some slight changes in the number of players that will be needed to complete some tasks. We have also tweaked the party system to create a more seamless experience, added new maps and did a ton of bug fixing.

Let's spell the changes out part by part!


Adapting the terminology
Science fiction transports players to futuristic contexts — often far removed from their own in both space and time — where scientific and technological innovations define everything. In contrast to fantasy works, here unlikely events must have a logical and rational basis. For this very reason, we understand that words like "magic", or “spells”, don’t fit a story like ours. Therefore, the upcoming patch will rename the elemental abilities of the Sainen: from now on, we’ll always refer to them as “Energies”.


⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/5cb4f3acc8fbff9042e5bb3136c5779b241e05a8.jpg

In this sci-fi context, the devices used by the Sainen to catalyze these energies of the Universe will be called “Shapers”, not “magic props”; and each player will be able to set four types of configuration depending on the ability we need to use.

Also, for the sake of consistency, the way in which the chosen shaper is configured will be called “configuration” instead of the previous “spell”.


Tweaked energies
The Sainen, as an advanced civilization, are capable of handling special energies that serve them as a way to interact with the environment in many different ways. 

There are 4 different types of energies, all related to a specific element:


 Airy: Levitation. Creates energy flows that make the player ascend and be able to access unreachable areas. It also prevents them from big falls. 
 Firei: Glowing Orb. The Firei energy becomes a light in the darkness, and can melt down certain objects. 
 Ether: Shade. Ether gives the players the ability to reshape themselves or other objects. This is useful to go through walls and strong structures to reach new areas.
 Jointer: Object transmutation. Jointer empowers your companions and creates new paths by energizing the environment.


⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/1733b23d6d48156cac39b3b4d72f61fa6bfae65e.jpg

In order to use the energies, each Sainen will first need to establish a link with the ability they want to master, and will have the option to practice in a tutorial level specifically designed for this purpose. Your kind has awakened after a long period of time, and will need to start all over again from scratch; thus, you will begin learning any ability from the basic level.

During your mission on planet Solarus, you will find some energy spikes to capture and get some “configurations”; that is, the way to set up the devices -”Shapers”- to generate the energies.


⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/36fcf0db775b2828d843dd7f49e88b73e98abe84.jpg

The energy skill levels range from 1 to 50, which is the highest. As you level up, using the energies will become increasingly difficult, even much more if you are trying to excel in all of them. Playing with friends means that each of your companions can specialize in one or two of these energies, depending on the number of players. However, it is also possible for only one player to master all of them -it’s extremely challenging, but achievable!


Multiplayer experience
Those Who Came is a multiplayer game. We recommend that you gather 4 friends to be able to enjoy the whole experience, but there are several missions that can be played in Single player mode, and others that will require a minimum of 2 players. For the last missions you may need all the 4 to complete the adventure. We have tweaked this number as before there were some missions that needed up to 7 players to be completed.


⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/5f82743d02937d2774478b60f50ac7abc2a86efa.jpg

Remember that as a crew, you have access to a PvP area called The Stadium that can only be enjoyed in multiplayer mode. It is a very exciting place where you can upgrade your equipment, earn Halis, and test your skills with the energy you have gathered -not individually, but with your friends! PvP can be played in two groups of 2, the minimum required, two groups of 3, or two groups of 4. There are several options for two different parties to play together, and have fun while mastering their energies!


⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/fad235802b2095c44034bd0ac227a6aae4fa62bd.jpg


New maps
Along their journey, the Sainen will have to learn about Solarus, the planet that is meant to be their new home: its surface, its environment, its fauna and flora, and how to establish contact with the natives. Solarus also changes its behaviour depending on the day and night cycles! 

The next update will bring some very interesting new areas to the map. For example, the Torek’s Cave, an unknown part of the planet with some environmental peculiarities, where the native inhabitants of the planet, the Torek, are surprisingly able to live. The Sainen will need to discover Solarus and its possibilities through the different missions; it’s a vast planet with many areas to explore, so it won’t be an easy task!


⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/ca1e641d601c313e46cf744d4982b403831f2d7f.jpg

All these new places will help the Sainen to understand more about Solarus' history, and discover relevant elements that will have a key impact on how to heal the planet and make it fit to live in. 


Characters
The update of Dec 9th will also bring new names to certain elements and characters in the story. We have been thinking on how some of them could be improved to better fit the story and the world we have created. With this in mind, we decided to rename some of them; the most remarkable changes are the name of the Sainen Commander, who we will call Artissa from now on, and the main ship, HERMAION.


⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/4d73ab66d2f2e463ee0d0fd05e592734f7c74bee.jpg

Another important decision has been to discard all characters’ voices. We realised that too many new recordings would be needed, as the number of NPCs with dialogues we had originally planned to include in the story had increased considerably. Instead, we will use very brief sounds to identify the speaker, and will most likely review sounds and voices thoroughly in upcoming updates. 


Bug fixing and QoL improvements
We have also added some hotfixes to this new update. Regarding our party system, for instance, we have solved several bugs in order to improve performance and stability, while including several quality of life improvements. Besides, as usual with a new update, we have polished the build to remove bugs. 




Here are all the things to look forward to on Dec 9th! 

For more news, updates, or a friendly chat about the game, we invite you to follow and join the conversations here on the Steam forums, our community on Discord, and our social media channels, Twitter, Instagram and Reddit.

Take care and have a great week!

notes.title: 3 days until the Early Access release!
notes.notes:
3 DAYS TO EARLY ACCESS

“Those Who Came”, the adventurous sci-fi non-combat-based RPG, will be coming to Steam in Early Access, on October 7, 2021


[previewyoutube=TXN7oj6Fz4Q;full][/previewyoutube]

After having a gameplay session and a #MeeTheDevs session in our discord. The THOSE WHO CAME game will be heading to an early access stage on the 7th of October, 2021. 
The game is best described as an original combination and goes beyond mixing up non-combat RPG and party gameplay with a stylized feeling to it.

In “Those Who Came”, your civilization has been forced into exodus and you just found Solarus. Choose your suits, mods, and gear up with extraordinary magic to change the world. Play as an airy, firei, ether, or jointer character as you explore the environment.
Add the game to your wishlist to receive more updates as well! 

See you all soon!
